manifesto.quote: Simplicity is not the result. It is the method.
manifesto.body: The aim is not to memorize hairstyles, but to understand the principles that make it possible to create freely.
manifesto.title: Simplicity is not the result. It is the method.

learning-path.heading: Where are you in your practice?

items.title: The Beginner
items.body: “I don’t know how to style hair.” — Learn by doing.

items.title: The Designer
items.body: “I know how to create hairstyles, but I still copy.” — Learn to observe and think.

items.title: The Professional
items.body: “I know how to design hairstyles; now I want to make this my profession.” — Learn to practice professionally.

items.title: The Signature Artist
items.body: “I want to find a voice of my own.” — Learn to leave a mark.

learning-path.title: Where are you in your practice?

items.title: Observe
items.body: Pay attention to form, texture, light, proportions and movement.

items.title: Understand
items.body: Think before executing. Develop judgment instead of memorizing techniques.

items.title: Create
items.body: Make intentional decisions and reduce your dependence on tutorials.

items.title: Practice
items.body: Growth depends on commitment, practice and each person’s individual process.

items.title: Courses
items.body: Learning experiences focused on understanding principles rather than memorizing techniques.

items.title: Mentoring
items.body: Individual sessions offered by prior reservation when available.

items.title: Workbooks
items.body: Downloadable resources for continued learning and practice.

closing.title: Every story begins with a conversation.
closing.body: If you want to ask about future courses, mentoring or workbooks, write to Nina directly.

items.title: Are programs available now?
items.content: Not yet. Courses, mentoring and workbooks are in preparation. This site does not currently include enrollment, reservations or payment.

items.title: Who is The Practice for?
items.content: For women who want to make hairstyling their profession, stop depending on copied techniques and develop a point of view of their own.

items.title: Do I need previous experience?
items.content: The path considers four stages: beginner, designer, professional and signature artist.

items.title: What is the learning focus?
items.content: Observing, understanding and creating with confidence; developing judgment; understanding before executing; and reducing dependence on tutorials.

items.title: How will course access work?
items.content: When courses become available, access will be personal. Duration, updates and refund terms will be explained on each course page.

items.title: How will mentoring work?
items.content: When offered, sessions will require prior reservation. Rescheduling, cancellation and response-time policies will be shared before confirmation.

items.title: Are specific results guaranteed?
items.content: No. Results depend on each person’s commitment, practice and individual process. Professional, economic or commercial results cannot be guaranteed.
